steps: Visit the Collector Office, Assistant Director, Backward Classes and Minority Welfare Department District Office to get the application form.
Fill in all mandatory fields, attach a passport-sized photograph, and attach copies of mandatory documents.
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the concerned authority within the prescribed period.
Request a receipt or acknowledgement containing submission details from the concerned authority.
parsed.department: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
